title: The kbgit.py docstring and the commit-msg hook header name the KB-Teams trailer
goal: kbgit.py's module docstring and .githooks/commit-msg list KB-Teams beside KB-Topics, KB-Sources-* and KB-Answers

run:
import sys
src = open("_tools/kbgit.py", encoding="utf-8").read().split('"""', 2)[1]
hook = open(".githooks/commit-msg", encoding="utf-8").read()
miss = [n for n, t in (("kbgit.py docstring", src), (".githooks/commit-msg", hook)) if "KB-Teams" not in t]
if miss:
    print("check failed: KB-Teams not named in", miss); sys.exit(1)
